        How to read this
        • Pool is lake surface elevation in feet as USGS posts it, not the depth of any hole or channel.
        • The ODNR fishing map’s depths are based on the 832 ft summer pool (3 ft contours, surveyed 1999). Contours are off by about (832 − pool).
        • No public water temp gauge on the lake, so the temp slot says n/a. Nothing is estimated.
        • Lake level comes from USGS gauge 03141000 at Senecaville. It is provisional and can be revised. USGS-03141000.
        • 399 hp limit (MWCD). Idle or no wake inside the buoyed and shore zones. Check Ohio’s BeachGuard for advisories before swimming.

        Tonight’s bite

        A rule of thumb guide, not a promise.

        How the bite is rated

        The Bite is this site’s own rule of thumb, not fishing science and not a forecast. It adds points from readings already on this page.

        • Barometer, the change over the last 3 hours at the lake’s NWS station. Falling slowly +2, steady +1, rising slowly 0, falling fast 0, rising fast −1. Steady means within 0.02 inHg; fast means 0.06 inHg or more.
        • Wind, tonight’s average NWS hourly speed from sunset to 2 AM (the top of each hour’s range). Under 3 mph 0, 3 to 12 mph +1, 13 to 18 mph 0, over 18 mph −2.
        • Moon, worked out on this phone. New or full moon tonight (or under 10% or over 90% lit) +1, otherwise 0.
        • Water temp, from this lake’s USGS gauge where one reports it. 55 to 80°F +1, colder than 45 or warmer than 86°F −1, anything between 0. It never makes a rating alone.
        • Thunder anywhere in tonight’s NWS forecast makes it Tough, whatever the points.

        4 points or more is Good, 2 or 3 is Fair, less is Tough. A missing reading counts 0, and with no barometer trend and no wind there is no rating.

              What this site is

              • Unofficial Ohio fishing hub with night-dock atmosphere: Hoover, Alum Creek, Buckeye Lake, O’Shaughnessy, Griggs, Indian Lake, Delaware Lake, Deer Creek Lake, Madison Lake, Knox Lake, Clear Fork Reservoir, Seneca Lake, Dillon Lake, Lake Logan, Salt Fork Lake, Burr Oak Lake, Dow Lake, Mosquito Creek Lake, Berlin Lake, West Branch Reservoir, Pymatuning Lake, Lake Milton and Leesville Lake
              • Species pages with limit reminders from the ODNR 2026–27 rules
              • One example log entry, marked Example · not ODNR / City / USGS
              Night fishing can be dangerous in storms, heat, and low visibility. Wear a life jacket when it calls for it. 399 hp limit · 15 in bass minimum · license ages 16+. See About.
